The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 fb3f3a7a4115f5ec), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 11-12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: For a geometric covector A ∈ T∗ b B \ Λ, there are an allowed leg y, such an H, a point h with p(h) = b and l(h) = y, a covector A′ ∈ T∗ o(h)B, and 0 ̸= ξ ∈ T∗ y U with p∗ A = q∗ H(A′ , ξ) at h. (3.3) The following sections have nondegenerate zeros at h: 1. on Hin = e p−1(b, y), the restriction of p∗A to the qH-vertical tangent bundle; 2. on Hout = q−1 H (o(h), y), the restriction of o∗A′ to the e p-vertical tangent bundle. 11 Each restriction is a section of the dual of the indicated vertical tangent bundle. The fibers include the identifications of the fixed bundles; these fibers and the vertical tangent bundles have dimension and rank m, respectively. The point y can be chosen in any prescribed nonempty open of a component on which A is not generically nilpotent.
